summary: Frontend-only validation for Ole Miss Proximity Promos. Tested 14 user-visible flows on mobile viewport (390x844). All 14 acceptance criteria PASSED: onboarding renders with navy/red theme + location/age toggles + Get started CTA, sign-in with admin@olemiss.app -> redirected to feed, feed shows 5 promo cards with bar/title/image/distance pill/event-type badge, filter chips (all/trivia/live_music/happy_hour) work (trivia chip filtered to 1 card), promo detail loads with hero/offers/valid-until and Generate-QR CTA, QR screen renders white-padded QR code + 8-char code + expiry countdown + Staff Tap to redeem (successfully transitions to Already-redeemed state with green checkmark), Bars tab lists 3 seeded bars with rating/distance/campus_area, Tickets tab shows Bronze tier loyalty card with points/progress/redeem button (disabled <100pts), Profile shows all preference/privacy toggles + save-prefs persists + signout returns to onboarding, bar_admin sees admin-create-promo + admin-analytics entries (correctly hidden for student role), Admin Create form posts new promo and redirects to Analytics, Analytics shows all 6 KPI tiles (kpi-redeems/views/saves/active/users/opt-in) + per-promo status pills, 4-tab bottom nav (Feed/Bars/Tickets/Profile). Zero console errors during the run. Network: all /api/promos and /api/bars returned 200. QR redeem bug fix verified end-to-end from UI (no 500). One minor non-blocker: a single Unsplash image (Rooster's Blues House thumbnail) returns ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB so the bar-card thumbnail is empty on the Bars list. Also observed: Bars screen does not fetch data when reached via direct URL navigation (goto /bars) - it loads fine when reached via the bottom tab. Likely a useFocusEffect/focus-event quirk on direct deep-link to a tab route; not a regression of the requested flows but worth a note for deep-link UX. Deprecated packages: none detected.

ui_bugs.issue: Bar list does not populate on first focus when the route is opened via a direct URL/deep link (page.goto('/bars')). Opening Bars via the bottom tab works correctly and renders 3 cards. Likely caused by useFocusEffect not firing on initial deep-link mount with an empty deps array on its inner useCallback. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bars.tsx:17-24
Rooster's Blues House image returns ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB (Unsplash). Thumbnail shows empty. Consider a fallback or different image URL. Reference: backend seed bar image_url for Rooster's Blues House.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bars.tsx switch to a useEffect or change useFocusEffect's inner useCallback deps so the data fetch runs on first deep-link mount (currently only fires when entering via tab).
OPTIONAL: Replace the Unsplash URL for Rooster's Blues House with a non-ORB-blocked source or a local asset fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: QR redeem 500 timezone fix is working end-to-end; UI transitions QR to 'Already redeemed' with green check on success.
All interactive elements have testID; Tabs render with role=tab; testIDs match the spec.
Theme tokens consistent: brand red #CE1126 + surface navy used across cards, chips, KPI tiles, CTAs.
Admin section in Profile is correctly role-gated (hidden for student@olemiss.app, shown for admin@olemiss.app).
All text wrapped in <Text>; no raw strings; uses StyleSheet.create everywhere; no className/CSS files.
seed_data_creation: Published one TEST_ promo via admin Create form during test; visible in analytics (kpi-active=6). Does not interfere with other flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested frontend flows pass. Two minor UX nits only (deep-link to /bars empty list, one broken Unsplash thumb). Use admin@olemiss.app/Admin123! and student@olemiss.app/Student123!. Navigate tabs by clicking [role=tab] containing 'Feed'/'Bars'/'Tickets'/'Profile' (avoid text=Bars locator since the onboarding copy 'your favorite bars' also matches).
rca_of_issue: Bars empty-on-deep-link: useFocusEffect(useCallback(load, [])) at bars.tsx:17 -- when the screen is mounted as the initial route via direct URL, the navigator's focus event may not fire before the callback subscribes, so load() never runs. Mitigation: replace with a plain useEffect on mount OR call load() inside the focus callback AND in a sibling useEffect.
